all_blockers.detail: The only paper-data link (ibm.box.com share) returns HTTP 404; no official mirror of the exact AP News/BNC/IMDB preprocessed bundle found. BNC itself is license-gated regardless.

Non-fatal: official tensorflow/tensorflow:0.12.1 image pulls fine but its Python 2.7.6 cannot do TLS SNI, so no deps installable inside it. Worked around with python:2.7 + pip install tensorflow==0.12.1.

agent_parsed_json.verdict_reason: Train→test pipeline runs end-to-end under Python 2.7 + TF 0.12.1 on the bundled toy data (outputs topics and perplexities), but the paper's real dataset link is dead so only a toy smoke test was possible.
